paper_verdict.estimator_family: OLS (cross-sectional robust OLS and FGLS, no panel, no instruments)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Single 2017 cross-section of 25 developing countries; exposure is an unstandardised composite index (range 1.51-2.91) so coefficients are per index point; productivity outcome is in levels (real GDP per employee), GNI per capita in logs (semi-elasticity), so units differ and are not comparable with elasticities; table reports no N or R-squared; FGLS adds OLS weights as a regressor (non-standard) and the OLS and FGLS rows use the same data (duplicates, not independent); table prints p-values, not SEs, so SEs must be derived; signs are lost in the converted text (direction taken from authors' statement of positive relations); the model is a conditional correlation framed partly causally.
